notes.title: Sub Rosa Alpha 36
notes.content:
[h1]Team Memo 10.21.19[/h1]
[b]The following correspondence is from the Sub Rosa Middle Management and is intended for current employees only.[/b]


[b]World Mode [New Prototype]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6587148/f0ae3adc63a74ee45508009fd5a8eb14d21ef7e9.png[/img]

The return of the much loved World Mode includes a new prototype city design, five companies to join, new mission types, and more. The World Mode will be updated over time so please consider this the first step towards a more polished and robust version.

[b]Trains[/b]
With the return of World Mode comes the return of the commuter train. This iteration has dedicated train stops, elevated tracks, and plenty of rooms for employees. Hijinks a plenty are waiting onboard.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G0PpFAz.gif[/img]

[b]Additional Servers[/b]
A new server added under the tag 'Cilantro' with the goal of adding more servers for more locations to better serve employees around the world.

[b]Criminal Rating systems:[/b]
Overview:
The criminal rating is a basic system designed to prevent griefing. It is being iterated on and will improve over time.

The corporate rating isn't used yet but eventually will allow for higher-level teams and different types of missions.

The damage a player inflicts gives the player criminal points and reflects on their criminal rating. 

Depending on where a player shoots or how many times they shoot someone will determine their criminal rating.

A player's criminal rating goes down 1 point every 1.5 minutes.
Damage inflicted on a criminal will be 20% of the original point value.

[b]Criminal Consequences:[/b]
[list]
[*]With a crime rating of 200 a player can not purchase items at the gun or car shop.
[*]With a crime rating of 500 a player can not spawn on the current server for 30 minutes.
[*]With a crime rating of 1000 a player gets banned from the server.
[/list]

[b]Civilians:[/b]
[list]
[*]100% of the damage a civilian player inflicts on another civilian is reflected in their criminal rating.
[*]200% of the damage a civilian player inflicts on a team member is reflected in their criminal rating.
[/list]

[b]Teams:[/b]
[list]
[*]A player's criminal rating does not go up if they inflict damage on their own team member or another team member outside of their respective bases.
[*]A player's criminal rating goes up if they inflict damage on a team inside of their base, even if the player is on the same team.
[*]100% of the damage a team member inflicts to another team member in their base is reflected on their criminal record.
[*]50% of the damage a team member inflicts on a civilian is reflected in their criminal rating.
[/list]

[b]New Employee Discount[/b]
Sub Rosa is 12% off until October 25.

notes.title: Versus Mode and Recruitment Drive
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6587148/f65b6c76bced718ec00613613985b5d2702938ec.jpg[/img]

[i]Photo courtesy of Employee TraceTheKitteh.
[/i]

[h1]Team Memo 7.11.19
The following correspondence is from the Sub Rosa Middle Management and is intended for current employees only.[/h1]

[h1]Versus Mode[/h1]
Our newest mode continues to receive small fixes that should provide a smoother gameplay experience. Some of these fixes will apply to other game modes as well. Continue to snipe rivals as they awkwardly slide down.

[h1]Recruitment Test[/h1]
Sub Rosa will be 11% off from July 12 - July 19 off. Please advise any potential employees. 

[h1]New Audio System[/h1]
An entirely new audio system is being worked on for the game, which should improve such things as positional sound and implementation of new audio effects. 

[h1]Game Improvements[/h1]
In preparing for the next update, many aspects of the game are in the process of adjustment. Car handling and better interaction/collision with map assets are among those currently in focus.

[h1]Art Updates[/h1]
Future game updates will soon see the implementation of interior art assets, with the current priority focused toward finishing and adding polish to the exterior buildings of the city map. 

[h1]Physics Adjustments[/h1]
Sub Rosa is a physics-based game at its core. As such, physics adjustments are a big part of the game’s development, and are ongoing. Currently we are looking at making player movement feel less “floaty”, and testing out more fine tuning of vehicles.

notes.title: Team Memo 6-10-2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6587148/5e43365b3f846dc7653516d42e048cc6d158c5fe.png[/img]
A quick update of some things we’ve been trying out:

[h1]Versus mode[/h1]
We made some tweaks to Versus mode, including an optional “buy time” where players are frozen at the beginning of the round, changing how the briefcases are spaced out, and adjusting the default respawn time.

[h1]Setmap command[/h1]
Admins can now easily change maps on-the-fly via the [b]/setmap[/b] command. For example, [b]/setmap 2[/b] will switch to the second map listed in the [b]config_versus.txt[/b] file.

[h1]Versus2[/h1]
We added a new map to Versus mode: [b]Versus2[/b]. Versus2 is a close-quarters map built for smaller player counts.

[h1]Workweek mode[/h1]
We’re trying out a new modification for Round mode and Versus mode. In Workweek, you're placed into a five-round tournament. Each round is played as they normally do, and at the conclusion of the final round, a winning team is declared.

[h1]Team Bonus[/h1]
We’re experimenting with a team bonus system where imbalanced teams with less players are given a higher bonus payout.

notes.title: Team Memo 6-3-2019
notes.content:
A quick update of some things we’ve been trying out:

[h1]Net code[/h1]
We're making some optimizations to the net code.

[h1]Movement code[/h1]
We're improving player movement, including tightening up how we handle momentum when players turn while moving.

[h1]Control changes[/h1]
We're experimenting with changing some controls, including having [b]Z[/b] to slide and [b]T[/b] to cycle through the Yell/Whisper/Normal talk volumes.

[h1]Purchasable briefcase[/h1]
We're trying out having briefcases be purchasable.

[h1]Versus mode[/h1]
We're testing out a new gamemode, Versus. In this gamemode, three suitcases are spawned in the middle of the map and two teams fight over them.

[h1]Bug report form[/h1]
If you spot any gameplay bugs, exploits, or map glitches, [i][b]please let us know![/b][/i] We’d love to include the fix in a future build. Our report form is located here:
https://form.jotform.com/90557091412959

Sincerely,
Sub Rosa Management

notes.title: Team Memo 5-6-2019
notes.content:
A quick update of some things we’ve been trying out:

[h1]Voicechat[/h1]
Players speaking on voicechat will soon have a tiny microphone icon flash over their heads when they speak, making it easier to identify who’s talking.  Additionally, we think we have a possible fix for voicechat sometimes not activating.

[h1]Hand animations[/h1]
We’re working on some basic hand animations for gun handling and reloading.

[h1]Admin system[/h1]
We’re making some changes that will make it easier for admins to control and maintain their servers. More details to come!

[h1]Car tweaks[/h1]
Cars are getting some tuning changes that will stabilize them more and reduce some sliding.

[h1]Bug report form[/h1]
Thanks to those who have submitted reports! It’s helping make the game much better, and the team appreciates it a ton. If you find any bugs, exploits, or map glitches, [b]please let us know:[/b] https://form.jotform.com/90557091412959

Sincerely,
Sub Rosa Management

notes.title: Team Memo 4-29-2019
notes.content:
A quick update of some things we’ve been trying out:

[h1]Controls changes[/h1]
We’re still experimenting with the control scheme. It’s a fairly extensive change, and it’s taking some time to make all of its pieces work well together.

[h1]Anti-cheat[/h1]
We’re working on a file verification system to prevent use of modified models that give an unfair advantage.

[h1]City changes[/h1]
We’ve made some improvements to the lighting and texture material system, so the city will look a bit different in the upcoming build.

Also: the city now has a boxing ring.

[h1]Bug report form[/h1]
Thanks to those who have submitted reports! It’s helping make the game much better, and the team appreciates it a ton. If you find any bugs, exploits, or map glitches, [b]please let us know:[/b] https://form.jotform.com/90557091412959


We’re mostly trying to wrap up this build and tie up all the miscellaneous loose ends. Sub Rosa is a complex game, and it gets increasingly more complex with each successive build. We appreciate your patience as we get all parts of the game ready for release.

Thank you for your support!

tags.feature: Also: the city now has a boxing ring.

notes.title: Team Memo 4-22-2019
notes.content:
A quick update of some things we’ve been trying out:

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Sub Rosa now has an official Discord server! Our goal is to make this an inclusive and supportive community, and we hope you'll join us: https://discord.gg/subrosa

[h1]Weapon stock[/h1]
When a weapon is fired, we’re experimenting with having the weapon stock collide better with the player body. The goal is to better stabilize the weapons, and so far the results are promising.

[h1]Eliminator mode[/h1]
We’re testing some tweaks to the Eliminator gamemode, such as having having Eliminator kills affect the round countdown timer.

[h1]Controls changes[/h1]
Still working on the control changes -- trying out some control schemes for the throwing system, and how player names are displayed.

[h1]City changes[/h1]
We added a variety of miscellaneous additions (footbridges, staircases) throughout the city and did a lot of bugfixing. 

[h1]Bug report form[/h1]
Thanks to those who have submitted reports! It’s helping make the game much better, and the team appreciates it a ton. If you find any bugs, exploits, or map glitches, [b]please let us know:[/b] https://form.jotform.com/90557091412959

The management team has been working diligently on various aspects of the software and want to share those tidbits with you regularly in the form of our weekly memo (See below). If you have questions, don't hesitate to reach out.

A quick update of some things we’ve been trying out:

[h1]Controls changes[/h1]
We’re in the process of streamlining the control scheme. There’s still a lot of testing and experimenting to be done here, so we’ll reveal more specifics once it’s more solidified.

[h1]HUD changes[/h1]
We’re testing some changes to the HUD, including displaying a live 3D wireframe of your player character. This will hopefully make it easier to read your health status and physical stance.

[h1]City updates[/h1]
The city is getting a bowling alley, and a handful of the downtown skyscrapers are getting stairwells & roof access.

[h1]Bug report form[/h1]
If you find bugs, exploits, or map glitches, please let us know! Sub Rosa is a complex game and we can use your help. Please write a bug report on this form: https://form.jotform.com/90557091412959 

Sincerely,
Sub Rosa Management

Sub Rosa - Alpha 31 is now live.

Gameplay Changes:

Timer counts down faster if all players are back in their base
Round mode start time is longer
Weapon handling adjustments
Damage and healing balances
Added dead drop location to map
Added admin GUI
Added server passwords

New Mode: Eliminator Mode

Players start in a random location in the city, each assigned one of three roles:

The Eliminator
The objective of the Eliminator is to kill the future resistance leader before the round ends. The Eliminator will have a red box appear in their HUD showing the future resistance leader’s last known location.

The Protector
The objective of the Protector is to stop The Eliminator by destroying it with grenades. The Protector knows which civilian is the future resistance leader.

Civilian/The Savior
The objective of all civilians is to survive. Unbeknownst to them, one civilian is the future savior of mankind and the target of the Eliminator.

notes.title: Sub Rosa Alpha 29a
notes.content:
Alpha 29a is now available on the default branch of Sub Rosa on Steam

-Mac and Linux versions
-optimized rendering
-optimized netcode
-lots of new buildings
-new mission types
-bases now have roof access
-added sliding (jump and then crouch in mid-air to activate)
-new main menu design
-added per-round lighting changes 

World mode:  There's still a lot of things we need to do before we can do a new version of world mode, hopefully we can start testing it in the next couple months.

The rendering is now using OpenGL 3.3, which should improve performance and compatibility.
